info.title: Preclinical Toxicology Study API
info.description: API for storing and retrieving preclinical safety and toxicology study data, including GLP-compliant repeat-dose toxicology, cardiovascular safety, and genotoxicity studies.

get.summary: Get animals enrolled in a study

study_id.description: Unique GLP study identifier assigned by the testing facility

sponsor_compound_id.description: Internal compound identifier assigned by the sponsoring organization

compound_name.description: Chemical or generic name of the investigational compound

cas_number.description: CAS Registry Number for the test article

study_type.description: Classification of the toxicology study design

regulatory_guideline.description: ICH or OECD guideline under which the study was conducted

glp_compliant.description: Whether the study was conducted under Good Laboratory Practice regulations

species.description: Test species used in the study

strain_or_breed.description: Strain (rodents) or breed (non-rodents) of the test animals

study_duration_days.description: Total duration of the dosing phase in calendar days

recovery_duration_days.description: Duration of the satellite recovery group observation period in days

dose_formulation.description: Vehicle or formulation used to prepare the test article

route_of_administration.description: Route by which the test article was administered to animals

number_of_dose_groups.description: Total number of treatment groups including vehicle control

noael_mg_kg_day.description: No Observed Adverse Effect Level in mg/kg/day as determined by the study director

study_director.description: Name of the GLP study director responsible for the study

testing_facility.description: Name of the contract research organization or internal facility conducting the study

animal_id.description: Unique animal identifier within the study (ear tag or microchip number)

dose_group_id.description: Treatment group designation (e.g., G1=vehicle, G2=low, G3=mid, G4=high)

dose_level_mg_kg_day.description: Nominal dose administered in milligrams per kilogram body weight per day

age_at_start_weeks.description: Age of the animal in whole weeks at the first day of dosing

body_weight_at_start_g.description: Body weight in grams recorded at randomisation prior to first dose

randomisation_date.description: Date on which the animal was allocated to its treatment group

satellite_group.description: Whether the animal belongs to a recovery satellite group

premature_death.description: Whether the animal died or was humanely killed prior to scheduled termination

cause_of_death.description: If premature death occurred, the recorded or probable cause

necropsy_date.description: Date on which the animal was terminated and necropsied

observation_id.description: Unique identifier for this observation record

observation_date.description: Calendar date on which the clinical observation was made

study_day.description: Day of study on which the observation was recorded (Day 1 = first dose day)

clinical_sign.description: Standardised clinical sign term (from a controlled vocabulary such as SEND or MedDRA)

severity_grade.description: Severity grade of the observed clinical sign

body_weight_g.description: Body weight in grams if this record is a body weight measurement

food_consumption_g_day.description: Mean daily food consumption in grams per animal per day over the interval

observer_id.description: Identifier of the study personnel who recorded the observation

reversibility.description: Assessment of whether the finding was reversible during the recovery period

record_id.description: Unique identifier for this organ weight record

animal_id.description: Reference to the animal from which the organ was collected

organ_name.description: Standardised name of the organ or tissue weighed at necropsy

absolute_weight_g.description: Absolute organ weight in grams measured at necropsy

relative_to_body_weight_pct.description: Organ weight expressed as a percentage of terminal body weight

relative_to_brain_weight_pct.description: Organ weight expressed as a percentage of brain weight

paired_organ.description: Whether the organ is a paired organ (e.g., kidneys, adrenals, testes); if true, weight is combined

weigh_condition.description: Condition of the organ when weighed

finding_id.description: Unique identifier for this histopathology finding

animal_id.description: Reference to the animal from which the tissue section was prepared

tissue.description: Anatomical tissue or organ from which the section was taken

finding_term.description: Standardised histopathology term describing the microscopic finding (INHAND nomenclature preferred)

severity_grade.description: Numerical or descriptive severity grade assigned by the pathologist

distribution.description: Anatomical distribution or zonation of the finding within the tissue

test_article_related.description: Pathologist's assessment of whether the finding is related to test article administration

adverse.description: Whether the finding is classified as adverse by the pathologist

pathologist_id.description: Identifier of the board-certified pathologist who made the diagnosis

peer_review_status.description: Status of pathology peer review for this finding

result_id.description: Unique identifier for this hematology result record

animal_id.description: Reference to the animal from which blood was collected

collection_date.description: Date on which the blood sample was collected

collection_timepoint.description: Study timepoint at which blood was collected (e.g., pre-dose, interim, terminal)

wbc_10e9_l.description: White blood cell count in units of 10^9 cells per litre

rbc_10e12_l.description: Red blood cell count in units of 10^12 cells per litre

hemoglobin_g_dl.description: Haemoglobin concentration in grams per decilitre

hematocrit_pct.description: Haematocrit expressed as a percentage of packed cell volume

mchc_g_dl.description: Mean corpuscular haemoglobin concentration in grams per decilitre

platelets_10e9_l.description: Platelet count in units of 10^9 cells per litre

neutrophils_10e9_l.description: Absolute neutrophil count in units of 10^9 cells per litre

lymphocytes_10e9_l.description: Absolute lymphocyte count in units of 10^9 cells per litre

monocytes_10e9_l.description: Absolute monocyte count in units of 10^9 cells per litre

reticulocytes_pct.description: Reticulocyte count expressed as a percentage of total red blood cells

aptt_s.description: Activated partial thromboplastin time in seconds

result_id.description: Unique identifier for this clinical chemistry result record

animal_id.description: Reference to the animal from which serum or plasma was collected

fasting_status.description: Whether the animal was fasted prior to sample collection

alt_u_l.description: Alanine aminotransferase (ALT/GPT) activity in units per litre — marker of hepatocellular damage

ast_u_l.description: Aspartate aminotransferase (AST/GOT) activity in units per litre — marker of liver and muscle damage

alp_u_l.description: Alkaline phosphatase activity in units per litre

ggt_u_l.description: Gamma-glutamyl transferase activity in units per litre

total_bilirubin_umol_l.description: Total bilirubin concentration in micromoles per litre

total_protein_g_l.description: Total serum protein concentration in grams per litre

albumin_g_l.description: Serum albumin concentration in grams per litre

globulin_g_l.description: Serum globulin concentration in grams per litre (calculated as total protein minus albumin)

creatinine_umol_l.description: Serum creatinine concentration in micromoles per litre — marker of renal function

bun_mmol_l.description: Blood urea nitrogen concentration in millimoles per litre

glucose_mmol_l.description: Serum glucose concentration in millimoles per litre

cholesterol_mmol_l.description: Total serum cholesterol in millimoles per litre

triglycerides_mmol_l.description: Serum triglyceride concentration in millimoles per litre

calcium_mmol_l.description: Serum ionised calcium concentration in millimoles per litre

phosphorus_mmol_l.description: Serum inorganic phosphorus in millimoles per litre

sodium_mmol_l.description: Serum sodium concentration in millimoles per litre

potassium_mmol_l.description: Serum potassium concentration in millimoles per litre

chloride_mmol_l.description: Serum chloride concentration in millimoles per litre
